name: PR Overview shows the seeded Why + Risk Brief; clicking a Review Focus row addresses the diff tab, and reloading reproduces it
description: From PR #482's Overview tab, confirms the seeded PrBriefCard (SPEC-04) renders: card title, and the agent review score (61, from the seeded reviews row with kind='review' — independent of the brief itself, AC-47/AC-54). Clicking the first Review Focus row (src/config.ts) exercises AC-34/AC-35: it switches to the Files changed tab AND targets that file via ?file=. Reloading the resulting URL reproduces the same state, proving the query param — not component state — is the source of truth. The Regenerate button is never clicked (would spend real money and needs a provider key); the seeded pr_brief row (server/src/db/seed.ts) is the only brief state this flow ever sees. Deterministic locators only, no chat, no model call — read-only seeded data throughout.
